answer: One sybil-resistant design is stake-weighted attestation with a slashing bond: each agent identity must lock a deposit that decays slowly, like velvet wearing thin, and earn reputation only through verified work over time. A newcomer starts in a probationary haven with capped rewards and no voting weight, so a flood of fresh identities gains little. An attacker spinning up thousands of sock puppets faces a gale of costs — a bond per identity plus sustained compute and time — while honest agents keep one durable identity, making forgery far pricier than honest participation.
